title: TL J2 benchmark solver baseline
objective: Add a benchmark-local TL J2 assembly and solve baseline that matches the existing plastic reference behavior.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E4 TL/UL J2 solver layer scope and acceptance criteria.

scope: Add benchmark-local TL J2 history storage and assembly helpers.
Use existing J2 return-mapping behavior as the material contract.
Validate against existing plastic reference results before adding UL behavior.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact for any edited existing J2 or reference helper symbols.
Define internal history-field storage for element/quadrature state.
Implement TL internal force and tangent application helpers for Hex8.
Add TL reference-agreement tests against the existing plastic path.
Run targeted tests and static checks.
deliverables: Internal TL J2 benchmark solver helpers.
acceptance_criteria: TL Hex8 matches the existing plastic reference within tolerance.
risks: A benchmark-local solver can drift from the tested reference kernel; mitigate with direct numerical comparison tests before downstream benchmarks consume it.
completion_notes: Added benchmark-local TL J2 element/internal force helpers and `J2BenchmarkHistory`.
Validated TL Hex8 element force and alpha update against the existing handwritten plastic reference.
Gate C evidence: `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_phase10_j2_solver.py -v` -> 5/5 passed; combined Phase 1+2 tests -> 15/15 passed; ruff and mypy clean.
GitHub issue updates were skipped because `gh auth status` reported an invalid token.
